title: Eggplant Parmigiana Bake
subtitle: with parmesan, mozzarella and tomato sauce
description: A quicker eggplant parmigiana where the slices are baked instead of fried, layered with tomato, parmesan and breadcrumbs and served with a warm tomato sauce. Sized for one 15x25 cm dish.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 190°C and line a tray with baking paper. Slice the eggplants into 1 cm rounds, thinly slice the tomatoes and finely chop the onion and garlic.
Make the sauce: sweat the onion in olive oil for 5 minutes until soft, add the garlic and, once fragrant, the oregano and canned tomatoes. Bring to the boil, cover and simmer on low for 15 minutes.
Arrange the eggplant slices on the tray, brush with olive oil and season with coarse salt. Bake for 15 to 20 minutes until soft and golden.
Spoon a layer or two of tomato sauce into a glass or ceramic dish and sprinkle with a little parmesan. Layer the eggplant, tomato and breadcrumbs in overlapping rows, then top with torn mozzarella.
Bake until golden and serve with the remaining hot tomato sauce over the top.
